newsitem.title: UK: Brit Borneo gains after visit institutions.
newsitem.headline: Brit Borneo gains after visit institutions.

text.p: Shares in British-Borneo Petroleum Syndicate Plc on Monday climbed 54 pence to 1,160, gaining fresh momemtum after a visit last week by institutional investors to the oil exploration firm's U.S. office in Houston, market makers said.

They added HSBC James Capel, which became British-Borneo's broker in the last quarter of 1996, was believed to have reiterated its strong buy stance on the stock ahead of a company meeting to industry analysts on Wednesday week.
The presentation is organised by the London Oil Analysts Group. Nobody at British-Borneo or James Capel were immediately available to comment.
British-Borneo, which has promising operations in the Gulf of Mexico, has powered ahead right from the beginning of the year.
It has added a total 350 pence since December 31 with the oil production and exploration sector index lagging by about 23 percent over the same period, according to Reuters price performance data.
Turnover in British-Borneo shares was 636,548 by 1552 GMT.
